products.title: Head Extreme Elite - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME ELITE - An intermediate range racket with the latest technology from Head Padel. Get better in the attack zone with it in your hands. Made with a new diamond mold. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

We analyze the HEAD EXTREME ELITE, the little sister of the Extreme series, but the bravest in terms of colors in its design, with a fluorine yellow aesthetic that attracts attention wherever it goes. Same diamond shape, high balance and power as the rest of the Head Extreme rackets, but with variety in its composition.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended for padel players with an intermediate or advanced level. It is an attacking racket for backhand players who want to attack on each point.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The most important construction data of the HEAD EXTREME ELITE are:

- Carbon fiber on the frame for high durability.

- The planes are made of the best fiberglass that the Head brand has. It gives us the necessary durability and comfort for a high ball output with little effort.

- Power Foam rubber inner core. It does not transmit any vibration to the player during the game.

- AUXETIC technology for the best experience that technology in a racket can give you. It adapts to every moment of the game.

- New Soft Buttcap technology, which is a new white cap on the handle that reduces vibrations. This one is orange.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, this new HEAD EXTREME ELITE is a powerful racket with good control thanks to its absorbent materials, such as fiberglass and power foam rubber. It will give us better solvency in attacking shots than in defense.

VIBORA YARARA PRO WHITE 2026 - Nueva temporada, nueva pala. Este modelo Yarara Pro White 2026 ahora con acabado brillante liso, es una pala todoterreno, genial para un juego polivalente. INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

Ya en Pádel Ibérico la nueva VIBORA YARARA PRO WHITE 2026, en la que veremos diferentes cambios como la implementación de carbono 3K para una mayor dureza y potencia.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

La VIBORA YARARA PRO WHITE 2026 se ha pensado para jugadores de nivel avanzado o profesional que buscan un equilibrio entre ataque y control. Su forma híbrida y la composición en carbono 3K la convierten en una pala muy polivalente.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

La Víbora Yarara Pro White representa una evolución en diseño y rendimiento dentro de la gama profesional de la marca. Mantiene el molde introducido en 2025, que mejora la aerodinámica y permite una mayor velocidad de reacción en jugadas exigentes.

El cambio principal para este año 2026 es la implementación de fibra de carbono 3K, lo que nos hace tener mayor potencia y un tacto un poco mas duro. En su núcleo tendremos Goma Eva Profesional.

Esta pala es ideal para reducir vibraciones gracias a las dos piezas de los laterales del puente, encargadas de ello.

products.title: Nox Start Grey Ex Js 2026 - Nox
products.description:
NOX START GRAY EX JS 2026 - High control racket, which is not intended to compete with the more technical NOX rackets. Its appeal is precisely in offering ease of play, comfort and good sensations at a more accessible price. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The NOX START GRAY EX JS 2026 is one of the trendy Nox rackets among intermediate level players looking for a comfortable, very versatile racket at a good price. Round format racket, to achieve high control at all times.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a padel racket especially suitable for beginner and intermediate level players who want to start playing more regularly.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The NOX Start Gray EX JS 2026 maintains the same philosophy of the Start family: a racket that is easy to play, comfortable and designed so that we can focus on improving our technique. This is a version with a bolder design in gray.

Its round shape favors a wide sweet spot and helps a lot when we still cannot center all the blows. It is precisely this ease that we like the most about the Start Gray.

The faces are built in FG 3K fiberglass, achieving a more flexible and pleasant response that facilitates ball exit. 

At the core we find the HR3 Soft rubber, which maintains that comfortable behavior and provides good response at low and medium speeds. For its part, the carbon frame provides greater consistency to the structure and helps improve its resistance with use.

products.title: Siux Stallion 12k 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX STALLION 12K 2026 - An incredibly powerful racket, for lovers of the diamond format and the best carbon fiber, the 12K. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The new SIUX STALLION 12K 2026 is a racket meticulously designed to offer the best sensations in the attack zone. Clearly due to its diamond format, we classify it as a power racket.

PLAYER TYPE

It is an excellent alternative within the range of Siux 2026 rackets for intermediate/advanced level players looking for a powerful, stable racket with a modern aesthetic.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX STALLION 12K 2026 shares the same diamond format as the successful Spyder series, offering attack-oriented balance and excellent power in spikes, volleys and overhead shots.

The chosen rubber that it incorporates is an EVA Core, which provides a perfect balance between power, comfort and ball output.

In addition, it integrates Optimus Holes technology, a perforation pattern designed to expand the sweet spot, improve stability and optimize the distribution of forces in each hit.
